title: MQAR v2 validity gate: attention (positive control) and swa(w=4) (no-memory baseline), 2 seeds, mastery curriculum, at P=16/T=64 and the K3 geometry P=64/T=256
why: C16/SQ59 are blocked because K3's attention control reached 8.6%. The CPU diagnostics (C170) show the recipe, not the task, was the problem. Gate: attn >= 90% and swa(4) <= 1/P + 5 points; otherwise the memory family stays unvalidated.
missing: recipe finalised from the CPU diagnostics (mastery curriculum steps for P=64 are extrapolated)
note: GPU use: tiny models (d=128, 2 layers). Results land in experiments/evalbattery/results/gate/*.json (per-arm accuracy + sequence-cluster bootstrap CI). Replaces Q15's design work (done on CPU).

title: K3 v2 (replaces Q16): MQAR recall with attn, swa(4), plain linear attention, GDN and GDN neg-eig, 3 seeds, at the geometry that cleared QB1
why: Settles C16 (vs plain linear attention only) and unblocks SQ59 (KDA vs GDN recall). Interpretable only if QB1 passed.
launch: bash experiments/launch/status.sh && GEOM=P16 STEPS=8000 bash experiments/evalbattery/run_mqar_k3v2.sh
note: 15 runs (5 arms x 3 seeds), about 2.5 min each at P=16/T=64/8k steps (GDN is slower than attention). Use GEOM=P64 STEPS=30000 only if QB1 showed attention clears the K3 geometry (then est 150 min: split per arm).

title: Iterative-computation suite, stage A (validity gate): attn4, GDN neg-eig 1-pass and label-shuffled controls on parity, modadd5, graph_hops, program (id + length/depth-generalisation splits), 20k steps, 1 seed
why: The 'do extra loops do useful work' testbed needs a reference model >= 90% in-distribution and shuffled controls at chance before any looped-vs-unlooped contrast is read. CPU tiny models (3k steps) are at chance on the graph tasks (C176).
note: 12 runs of 20k steps at ~5 ms/step (T <= 128) plus 4 shuffled controls of 5k steps. Output experiments/evalbattery/results/itercomp_gpu/*.json.

title: Iterative-computation suite, stage B: looped vs unlooped at matched compute (attn4 vs attn1x4, gdn4/gdn1x4, neg-eig variants) on 5 tasks, 2 seeds, depth-generalisation drop as the headline
why: C18/C22/C179: the direct loops test with the validity gate in place; reports id and gen accuracy with paired item bootstrap CIs.
missing: QB3 gate passed (reference >= 90% id for each task; tasks that fail are dropped, not interpreted)
note: 60 runs (5 tasks x 6 arms x 2 seeds), ~1.5 min each at 20k steps. Split by task if a slot is short.

title: Battery on the existing seed-0 checkpoints (E0, E1, E2): language modelling (val + fresh + line-shuffle control), code-native state-tracking probe (18 cells x 1,100), battery recall (n=1,100)
why: First four-family numbers and the floor check (C172): which cells are interpretable (lower CI >= 35%) on real checkpoints. Extends Q14 (tier 1) with the battery tasks.
missing: E1/E2 via lm-eval need flash-linear-attention in ~/.venvs/gogeta-eval (QB10, human); the standalone probe scorer works now in ~/.venvs/gogeta
launch: for c in E0-20261122-122059-s0 E1-20261122-124440-s0 E2-20261122-132340-s0; do ~/.venvs/gogeta/bin/python -m evals.battery.score_state_track --checkpoint ~/fusiondance-data/checkpoints/$c/model.pt --device cuda --bs 32 --out experiments/evalbattery/results/state_track_${c%%-*}_gpu.json; done
note: Probe: 18 cells x 1,100 items x 4 choices = 79k sequences of 70-600 tokens, about 4 GPU-min per checkpoint (CPU: ~46 s for 48 items at k=8 d=64). The lm-eval half (tier 1 + gogeta_battery_val_lineshuf_bpb + gogeta_battery_recall_d*, ~8 min each) runs after QB10: `~/.venvs/gogeta-eval/bin/python -m evals.run_suite --checkpoint <model.pt> --tasks gogeta_val_bpb,gogeta_uncheatable_py_bpb,gogeta_battery_val_lineshuf_bpb,gogeta_battery_recall_d64,gogeta_battery_recall_d256,gogeta_battery_recall_d512,gogeta_battery_recall_d960 --device cuda --log-samples`.

title: Functional family on E0/E1/E2: HumanEval+ and MBPP+ greedy pass@1 (+ clean twins), CRUXEval-O, and the canonical-solution / stub harness gate
why: C177: is F above the 5% floor at all? The harness gate (canonical = 100%, stub = 0%) validates plumbing without a strong model.
missing: no KV cache in gogeta/hf.py: generation recomputes the prefix every token (CPU: 46 generations took 223 s)
note: E0 only until fla is installed in the eval venv; then repeat for E1/E2 (est 15 min each). Greedy tier 2 only; the n=20 sampled tier (2s) is about 20x and belongs in a separate item if pass@1 clears 5%.

title: Post-Phase-2b battery on all 3-seed checkpoints (E10 x3, E1 x3, E11 x3, plus E9, E2 and E0 at the tuned LR): language modelling + probe + recall
why: The paired-document bootstrap for hybrid vs attention (P1) and the 2x2 interaction contrast inputs (P4) need per-doc scores for every seed; also the loops-vs-control comparison E2 vs E9 (P2).
missing: Phase 2b checkpoints (Q7, Q8, E9, Q10, Q17 not done)
fla in the eval venv (QB10) for the GDN checkpoints
E10 loads through the HF-dir path (not tested here)
launch: for run in $(ls ~/fusiondance-data/checkpoints | grep -E '^(E10|E1|E11|E9|E2|E0)-'); do ~/.venvs/gogeta-eval/bin/python -m evals.run_suite --checkpoint ~/fusiondance-data/checkpoints/$run/model.pt --tasks gogeta_val_bpb,gogeta_uncheatable_py_bpb,gogeta_battery_val_lineshuf_bpb,gogeta_battery_recall_d64,gogeta_battery_recall_d960 --device cuda --log-samples; done
note: 12 checkpoints x ~8 min. Select the Phase 2b runs by name (the glob also matches K7 sweep runs; filter to the 200M-token runs listed in the Phase 2b campaign file) before launching. --log-samples keeps per-doc (ll, bytes) pairs for the paired bootstrap.

title: Loop-count sweep of the state-tracking probe on E2 (and its unlooped control E9): r = 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 on the incr and assign k in {2,4} d in {0,16} cells
why: P2 at checkpoint level: does an extra loop change the probe score? Interpretable only if some cell clears the floor gate (QB4); otherwise reports a null on a floored task.
missing: QB4 shows at least one interpretable cell
launch: for r in 1 2 3 4 6 8; do ~/.venvs/gogeta/bin/python -m evals.battery.score_state_track --checkpoint ~/fusiondance-data/checkpoints/<E2 run>/model.pt --loops $r --cells assign:2:0,assign:4:16,incr:2:0,incr:4:16 --device cuda --bs 32 --out experiments/evalbattery/results/state_track_E2_r$r.json; done
note: Replace <E2 run> with the E2 checkpoint name; E9 has no loops (single run).
